title.narrative: Creative Industries for Employment without Borders

description.narrative: The project plans to use cross-border resources and potentials of 12 local communities and strengthen employment opportunities in the sector of creative industries. Thus, two resource centres will be established for the development of creative industries and the cross-border cooperation amongst accredited private employment intermediaries established.
